Cloud sync

Manually upload a snapshot or download and merge another device's snapshot. Includes saved drafts and memory notes; no file/audio bytes. Chats with conflicting content are kept as separate copies. Local or cloud deletion does not automatically delete the other copy.

Automatic sync

Upload saved chats, drafts and memory notes to the signed-in account. Defaults off. Deletions and conflicts pause for manual review.

Check which account is shown above. Signing in never uploads local data automatically. Importing memory notes keeps their current on/off setting.
